articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin Suffers Cyberattack as Researchers Flag $40 Million in Suspicious Crypto Transfers
articles.summary:
Brazilian cryptocurrency exchange Mercado Bitcoin suspended deposits and withdrawals on November 2, 2026, after detecting a security incident in one of its systems. Blockchain security firm Hypernative flagged more than $40 million in suspicious transfers across at least 10 blockchains, raising questions about the scope of the breach. The exchange has not confirmed that amount […]

articles.title: Hackers Using Microsoft Teams Messages and Calls to Trick Users and Gain Remote Access to System
articles.summary:

articles.title: Northflank Security Breach Leads to Unauthorized AI API Key Usage, Customers Urged to Rotate Secrets
articles.summary:
Northflank urged customers to rotate all platform secrets after reports of unauthorized AI API key use, warning that environment variables across workloads, secret groups, and global settings may have been exposed. Northflank is investigating a security incident involving reported misuse of AI keys but has not confirmed the entry point, identified an attacker, or disclosed […]

articles.title: POC Released for Windows WinSock Ancillary Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
articles.summary:
A public proof-of-concept exploit for CVE-2023-21768 shows how attackers with local access can gain SYSTEM privileges through the Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock. Researchers Valentina Palmiotti, known as chompie, and Ruben Boonen published the code. Their complete exploit targets vulnerable Windows 11 22H2 systems. articles.title: Hackers Exploit ChatGPT’s Popularity With Fake Billing Notices That Target Credit Cards and OTPs
articles.summary:

The campaign combines convincing subscription warnings with a live operator who can decide when to request a verification code, potentially helping approve an unauthorized payment. articles.title: Hackers Impersonate ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity AI Bots to Hunt for Passwords and API Keys
articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Use CyberStrikeAI Agents to Automate Windows Domain Takeovers and Credential Theft
articles.summary:
Hackers are now using an AI-driven command framework called CyberStrikeAI to break into Windows networks and take over entire domains.
